Talebin gelir esnekliği: Or income elasticity, in short εY: a basic type of elasticity showing by what percentage the quantity demanded of a certain product changes as a result of a one percent increase in consumers' income.
Talebin çapraz fiyat esnekliği: Or cross price elasticity, in short εXP: a basic type of elasticity showing by what percentage the quantity demanded of one related product changes as a result of a one percent increase in another product's price.
Talep: A fundamental economic concept describing how much of a product the buyers in the market want to purchase, and can purchase, in a given period.
Talep eğrisi: A graphical tool showing the relationship between the price of a good and the quantity demanded, all else being constant.
Talep fazlası: Or a shortage: the situation in which the quantity demanded in the market exceeds the quantity supplied.
Talep yasası: A fundamental economic concept stating that, all else being constant, as the price of a good rises, the quantity demanded of that good will gradually decrease or remain the same.
Talep çizelgesi: A list showing how much of a product is demanded at different price levels in a given period.
Talep şoku: A change in aggregate demand in the economy due to an effect other than the general price level.
Tam bilgi: The situation in which everyone concerned knows all the information — such as price, quality, quantity and production method — that could affect an economic activity.
Tam esnek ilişki: The other variable's responding at an infinite rate in the face of the smallest change in one variable.
Tam fiyat ayrımcılığı: Or first-degree price discrimination: the practice of selling a certain product to each buyer at the highest price that buyer is willing to pay for it.
Tam ikame: Products or inputs that can be used in place of one another in every case.
Tam istihdam: The unemployment rate in the situation where there is no cyclical unemployment and the realized unemployment equals natural unemployment.
Tam istihdam bütçe dengesi: Or the structural budget balance: the public budget balance realized when the economy is at the potential GDP level.
Tam katı ilişki: The other variable's not responding at all in the face of an infinite change in one variable.
Tam rekabet: The theoretical market structure in which there are a great many buyers and sellers possessing full information, the product is homogeneous, and there is no barrier to entry into the market.
Tam tamamlayıcı: Products or inputs that are used together in every case.
Tanıma gecikmesi: The period passing between the formation of an adverse situation across the economy and this situation's being understood by the economists.
Tapu Senedi: The term for the official document drawn up by the Land Registry Directorate showing the owner of a real estate. Apart from real estates, a title deed can also be drawn up in the establishment of independent and perpetual rights.
Tarife: The taxes the state applies to imported goods and services.
Tarım dışı işsizlik oranı: The percentage showing the share of the population seeking work outside agriculture within the non-agricultural labor force in an economy.
Tarım Ürünleri Üretici Fiyat Endeksi: The index measuring the price changes relating to agricultural activity within the framework of agriculture, hunting, forestry and fishing.
Tasarruf: The portion of income not spent on consumption, as a result of the postponement of consumption to a future date. The desire to earn more in the future, or the instinct of taking precautions against unexpected situations that may arise later, are among the reasons increasing individuals' saving tendencies.
Tasarruf Açığı: In a certain period, the amount of external financing needed for investments to be able to be financed in the event that total domestic savings cannot cover total domestic investments.
Tasarruf fonksiyonu: The mathematical relationship showing how private savings change, depending on fundamental variables such as the income level, in an economy.
Tavan fiyat: The highest sale price determined by the state for a good or service.
Taşıma ticareti: Or currency carry trade: the transaction of making gains by borrowing in a currency yielding low interest and investing in a currency yielding high interest.

Tefecilik: The lending of money under immoral or harassing conditions.

Tek Durak Ofis: The administrative structure ensuring that investors' bureaucratic transactions relating to their investments are concluded in the shortest time through a single authority, and employing experts within it.
Tek fiyat yasası: The view maintaining that, in the absence of transportation costs and trade barriers, product prices will be the same in every country.
Tek Hat Şeması: The diagram requested in renewable energy investments, approved by an electrical/electrical-electronics engineer, showing the electricity distribution system.
Tek Pencere Sistemi: The application within e-government in which taxpayers entered data for their customs-related transactions (imported machinery-equipment, inward processing, etc.) until 13.08.2018. Tekel gücü: A buyer's or seller's being able to decide on the market price of a certain product, or to prevent competition.
Tekel ya da monopol: A market structure in which a product without close substitutes is supplied by a single seller, and obstacles lie before the entry of other sellers into the market.
Tekelci: The firm that is the sole seller of a product without close substitutes.
Tekelci rekabet: The market structure in which there are a great many buyers and sellers possessing incomplete information, product differentiation is carried out, and there is no barrier to entry into the market.
Tekelci sömürü: The difference arising, owing to imperfect competition, between a production factor's price and its marginal revenue product.
Teknik Analiz: The making of price forecasts for the future by analyzing past-period market movements on the basis of indicators such as price and volume. For this purpose, use is made of various chart formations and statistical methods. It rests on the assumption that the formations arising on the charts because of past price movements constitute an indicator for the future, and hence that such formations can be used as an indicator for purchases and sales. Such analyses predict, for example, that the lowest prices realized in the past — in other words, the points at which prices began to rise — are 'support points', and hence these points should be awaited (be the criterion) for purchases, and again that the highest prices realized in the past are 'resistance' points and should be taken into account for sales.
Teknik Destek Programı: The support program provided by the Development Agencies, through their own personnel or, in cases of necessity, through procurement of services, to the institutional-quality and capacity-developing activities of non-profit institutions and organizations for works that can contribute to local and regional development.
Teknokent: The organized research and business center in which universities, research institutions and industrial organizations pursue their research, development and innovation activities in the same environment, produce value-added products, carry out knowledge and technology transfer among one another, and the academic, economic and social structure is integrated.
Teknoloji Geliştirme Bölgesi: The organized research and business center in which universities, research institutions and industrial organizations pursue their research, development and innovation activities in the same environment, produce value-added products, carry out knowledge and technology transfer among one another, and the academic, economic and social structure is integrated.
Teknolojik bilgi: The accumulation of knowledge regarding how the resources will be used in the production process.
Tektip ürün: Products that can be offered by different sellers but that are indistinguishable, in the consumer's eyes, in form and quality.
Telif hakkı: The legal privileges held for a certain period over a literary or artistic work.

Temsili para: General payment instruments that have no significant concrete use value but that can, when desired, be converted into a certain amount of valuable metal.
Tepki fonksiyonu: The mathematical relationship describing how an economic unit's behavior changes depending on the other economic units.
